query: Among Part 121 passenger reports, how many distinct incidents describe a go-around or missed approach primarily triggered by each of unstable_approach, traffic_spacing, and runway_occupancy, and which crew or ATC role most often initiated the maneuver in each category? SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, far_part, mission])
-> FILTER(far_part = 'Part 121' AND mission = 'Passenger')
-> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
-> SEM_EXTRACT("Emit one row only when the reporting aircraft performed a go-around or missed approach primarily because of unstable approach, traffic spacing, or runway occupancy rather than equipment failure. query: Among Part 121 airport-associated reports whose navigation-in-use records name FMS/FMC or GPS and whose event rows contain an automation detector or result, how many distinct incidents have each primary crew response: followed_automation, overrode_or_disconnected, or sought_atc_clarification? Use that order as precedence when several responses occur. A clear narrative action may establish the response; when it is absent, an unambiguous structured automation result may do so.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_responses := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, far_part, locale_reference_type])
  -> FILTER(far_part = 'Part 121' AND locale_reference_type = 'Airport')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Extract one dominant narrative_response from {followed_automation,overrode_or_disconnected,sought_atc_clarification} when the crew action is clear, using that precedence; otherwise output null.", {incident_id:string, narrative_response:string|null}, {incident_id,text})
)
navigation_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, aircraft_attributes.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER(attribute = 'nav_in_use' AND (value CONTAINS 'FMS Or FMC' OR value CONTAINS 'GPS'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {navigation_in_use:COLLECT(value)})
)
responses_with_navigation := JOIN(left=semantic_responses, right=navigation_records, join_type=inner, condition=semantic_responses.incident_id = navigation_records.incident_id)
automation_events := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(event_type IN ('detector','result') AND label CONTAINS 'Automation')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {automation_event_labels:COLLECT(event_type,label)})
)
joined := JOIN(left=responses_with_navigation, right=automation_events, join_type=inner, condition=responses_with_navigation.incident_id = automation_events.incident_id)
joined
-> PROJECT([incident_id,response_pattern=COALESCE(narrative_response,CASE WHEN automation_event_labels CONTAINS 'Flight Crew FLC complied w / Automation / Advisory' THEN 'followed_automation' WHEN automation_event_labels CONTAINS ANY OF ['Flight Crew FLC Overrode Automation','Flight Crew Overrode Automation'] THEN 'overrode_or_disconnected' ELSE NULL END)])
-> FILTER(response_pattern IS NOT NULL)
-> GROUP_BY([response_pattern], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id)})

  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, state_reference])
  -> FILTER(state_reference = 'US')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Identify the parties involved in the closest conflict as a phrase of at most six words and extract explicitly stated narrative horizontal and vertical closest-separation values in feet; use null for an unstated dimension.", {incident_id:string, parties_involved:string, narrative_horizontal_ft:integer|null, narrative_vertical_ft:integer|null}, {incident_id,text})
)
structured_distances := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(event_type = 'miss_distance')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {structured_horizontal_ft:MIN_IF(PARSE_INTEGER(label),label STARTS_WITH 'Horizontal '), structured_vertical_ft:MIN_IF(PARSE_INTEGER(label),label STARTS_WITH 'Vertical ')})
  -> FILTER(structured_horizontal_ft IS NOT NULL AND structured_vertical_ft IS NOT NULL)
)
joined := JOIN(left=semantic_distances, right=structured_distances, join_type=inner, condition=semantic_distances.incident_id = structured_distances.incident_id)
joined
-> PROJECT([incident_id,parties_involved,structured_horizontal_ft,structured_vertical_ft,narrative_horizontal_ft,narrative_vertical_ft,horizontal_comparison=CASE WHEN narrative_horizontal_ft IS NULL THEN 'not_stated' WHEN narrative_horizontal_ft=structured_horizontal_ft THEN 'matches' ELSE 'differs' END,vertical_comparison=CASE WHEN narrative_vertical_ft IS NULL THEN 'not_stated' WHEN narrative_vertical_ft=structured_vertical_ft THEN 'matches' ELSE 'differs' END])
-> ORDER_BY([structured_horizontal_ft ASC, structured_vertical_ft ASC, incident_id ASC])
-> LIMIT(20)
-> PROJECT([rank=ROW_NUMBER(),incident_id,parties_involved,structured_horizontal_ft,structured_vertical_ft,narrative_horizontal_ft,narrative_vertical_ft,horizontal_comparison,vertical_comparison])

query: Among Human Factors-primary incidents that were operated IFR and carry an ATC Issue All Types or Procedural Clearance anomaly, how do distinct-incident counts vary across four flight-phase groups and five primary clearance-conflict mechanisms? Phase groups are ground_or_departure, climb_or_cruise, descent_or_approach, and landing_or_other; mechanisms are late_or_changed_clearance, misunderstood_clearance, readback_hearback_failure, route_or_heading_confusion, and altitude_or_speed_restriction. Count a report only when one mechanism is clearly primary.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_mechanisms := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, primary_problem, flight_phase])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem = 'Human Factors')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_GROUP_BY("Assign one primary clearance-conflict mechanism from late_or_changed_clearance, misunderstood_clearance, readback_hearback_failure, route_or_heading_confusion, and altitude_or_speed_restriction. Omit reports without one clearly primary mechanism.", target_labels=[late_or_changed_clearance,misunderstood_clearance,readback_hearback_failure,route_or_heading_confusion,altitude_or_speed_restriction], input_bindings={incident_id,text})
)
ifr_incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, aircraft_attributes.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER(attribute = 'flight_plan' AND value = 'IFR')
  -> DEDUP([incident_id])
)
mechanisms_with_ifr := JOIN(left=semantic_mechanisms, right=ifr_incidents, join_type=inner, condition=semantic_mechanisms.incident_id = ifr_incidents.incident_id)
clearance_anomalies := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(event_type = 'anomaly' AND label IN ('ATC Issue All Types','Deviation / Discrepancy - Procedural Clearance'))
  -> DEDUP([incident_id])
)
joined := JOIN(left=mechanisms_with_ifr, right=clearance_anomalies, join_type=inner, condition=mechanisms_with_ifr.incident_id = clearance_anomalies.incident_id)
joined
-> PROJECT([incident_id,clearance_conflict_type,flight_phase_group=CASE WHEN flight_phase CONTAINS ANY OF ['Parked','Taxi','Takeoff','Initial Climb'] THEN 'ground_or_departure' WHEN flight_phase CONTAINS ANY OF ['Climb','Cruise'] THEN 'climb_or_cruise' WHEN flight_phase CONTAINS ANY OF ['Descent','Approach'] THEN 'descent_or_approach' ELSE 'landing_or_other' END])
-> GROUP_BY([flight_phase_group,clearance_conflict_type], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id)})

query: Among Human Factors-primary reports whose communication-breakdown records involve flight crew with ATC or flight crew with flight crew, how many distinct incidents in each participant group primarily involve phraseology, timing_or_late_information, assumption_or_expectation, task_division_or_role, or failure_to_challenge? Count a participant-group and mechanism combination only when the narrative clearly supports both; the same incident may contribute to both participant groups.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_pairs := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, primary_problem])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem = 'Human Factors')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Emit one row for every clearly supported participant group, using communication_pair from {flight_crew_atc,flight_crew_flight_crew} and one primary breakdown_mode from {phraseology,timing_or_late_information,assumption_or_expectation,task_division_or_role,failure_to_challenge}.", {incident_id:string, communication_pair:string, breakdown_mode:string}, {incident_id,text})
)
communication_pair_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, person_factors.csv, [incident_id, factor_type, value])
  -> FILTER(factor_type = 'communication_breakdown' AND value CONTAINS 'Flight Crew')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {communication_pair_records:COLLECT(value)})
)
joined := JOIN(left=semantic_pairs, right=communication_pair_records, join_type=inner, condition=semantic_pairs.incident_id = communication_pair_records.incident_id AND ((communication_pair = 'flight_crew_atc' AND EXISTS(record IN communication_pair_records WHERE (record CONTAINS 'Party1 Flight Crew' AND record CONTAINS 'Party2 ATC') OR (record CONTAINS 'Party1 ATC' AND record CONTAINS 'Party2 Flight Crew'))) OR (communication_pair = 'flight_crew_flight_crew' AND EXISTS(record IN communication_pair_records WHERE record CONTAINS 'Party1 Flight Crew' AND record CONTAINS 'Party2 Flight Crew'))))
joined
-> GROUP_BY([communication_pair,breakdown_mode], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id)})

Issue categories are passenger_medical, security_or_behavior, cabin_equipment_or_door, boarding_or_deplaning, and flight_attendant_communication; decision categories are delay_or_cancel, return_or_divert, continue_changed, and other_operational_change. Cabin-service-only details do not qualify. Rank by distinct-incident count, then the two category names.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_decisions := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, far_part, mission])
  -> FILTER(far_part = 'Part 121' AND mission = 'Passenger')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Emit one row only when a cabin-side issue directly caused a flight-deck operational change rather than only affecting cabin service. Assign issue_category from {passenger_medical,security_or_behavior,cabin_equipment_or_door,boarding_or_deplaning,flight_attendant_communication} and decision_category from {delay_or_cancel,return_or_divert,continue_changed,other_operational_change}.", {incident_id:string, issue_category:string, decision_category:string}, {incident_id,text})

-> GROUP_BY([issue_category,decision_category], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id)})
-> ORDER_BY([incident_count DESC, issue_category ASC, decision_category ASC])

joined

query: Among Part 121 airport-associated reports, which five incidents with an Automation Aircraft RA or TA detector and both horizontal and vertical miss distances show the most difficult conflict between automation guidance and an ATC instruction in the same episode? Rank direct_conflict above modified_or_delayed_compliance and clarification_required; within a pattern, use smaller horizontal separation, smaller vertical separation, then lower incident ID. Include short phrases for the automation guidance and ATC instruction.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_conflicts := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, far_part, locale_reference_type])
  -> FILTER(far_part = 'Part 121' AND locale_reference_type = 'Airport')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Emit one row only when automation guidance and an ATC instruction were difficult to reconcile in the same episode. Assign reconciliation_pattern from {direct_conflict,modified_or_delayed_compliance,clarification_required}, and express automation_guidance and atc_instruction in at most eight words each.", {incident_id:string, reconciliation_pattern:string, automation_guidance:string, atc_instruction:string}, {incident_id,text})

-> ORDER_BY([severity_order ASC,horizontal_separation_ft ASC,vertical_separation_ft ASC,incident_id ASC])

query: Among Aircraft-primary reports with a maintenance records-complete or required-correct-document status and a component problem record, which documentation-issue and status combinations occur most often, up to fifteen combinations in total? Documentation types are incomplete_or_inaccurate_logbook, missing_or_incomplete_work_card, incorrect_or_incomplete_mel_procedure, missing_required_document, and release_or_signoff_error. Count only actual documentation problems rather than mechanical discrepancies alone. Rank by distinct-incident count, then documentation type and the two status values, and include a canonical affected item as a short phrase.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
documentation_issues := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id,text_file,primary_problem])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem = 'Aircraft')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id,text])
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports describing an actual maintenance-documentation problem that affected a component or required item, rather than a mechanical discrepancy alone.", {text})
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Assign documentation_issue_type from {incomplete_or_inaccurate_logbook,missing_or_incomplete_work_card,incorrect_or_incomplete_mel_procedure,missing_required_document,release_or_signoff_error}, and extract the affected item as a phrase of at most six words.", {incident_id:string,documentation_issue_type:string,affected_item:string}, {incident_id,text})
)
documentation_status := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, aircraft_attributes.csv, [incident_id,attribute,value])
  -> FILTER(attribute IN ('maintenance_status_records_complete','maintenance_status_required_correct_doc_on_board'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {records_complete:MAX_IF(value,attribute='maintenance_status_records_complete'),correct_document_on_board:MAX_IF(value,attribute='maintenance_status_required_correct_doc_on_board')})
)
issues_with_status := JOIN(left=documentation_issues, right=documentation_status, join_type=inner, condition=documentation_issues.incident_id = documentation_status.incident_id)
component_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, components.csv, [incident_id,attribute,value])
  -> FILTER(attribute IN ('aircraft_component','problem'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {structured_components:COLLECT_IF(value,attribute='aircraft_component'),structured_problems:COLLECT_IF(value,attribute='problem')})
)
joined := JOIN(left=issues_with_status, right=component_records, join_type=inner, condition=issues_with_status.incident_id = component_records.incident_id)
joined
-> GROUP_BY([documentation_issue_type,records_complete,correct_document_on_board], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id),canonical_affected_item:MODE(affected_item)})
-> ORDER_BY([incident_count DESC,documentation_issue_type ASC,records_complete ASC,correct_document_on_board ASC])
-> LIMIT(15)
-> PROJECT([rank=ROW_NUMBER(),documentation_issue_type,records_complete,correct_document_on_board,incident_count,canonical_affected_item])

query: Among Air Carrier airport-associated incidents with a Ground Conflict, Ground Incursion, or Ground Excursion event, how many distinct reports in low_light versus daylight explicitly describe each visual factor as materially contributing? Treat Night, Dusk, and Dawn as low_light; factors are reduced_visibility, inadequate_or_confusing_lighting, glare, missed_visual_scan, and obscured_signage_or_markings. An incident may count for more than one supported factor, but incidental mentions do not count.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
semantic_factors := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id,text_file,aircraft_operator,locale_reference_type])
  -> FILTER(aircraft_operator = 'Air Carrier' AND locale_reference_type = 'Airport')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id,text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Emit one row for every visual factor materially contributing to the ground conflict, normalized to reduced_visibility, inadequate_or_confusing_lighting, glare, missed_visual_scan, or obscured_signage_or_markings. Do not emit incidental mentions.", {incident_id:string,visual_factor:string}, {incident_id,text})
)
light_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, environment_attributes.csv, [incident_id,attribute,value])
  -> FILTER(attribute = 'light' AND value IN ('Night','Dusk','Dawn','Daylight'))
  -> PROJECT([incident_id,light_group=CASE WHEN value IN ('Night','Dusk','Dawn') THEN 'low_light' ELSE 'daylight' END])
  -> DEDUP([incident_id,light_group])
)
factors_with_light := JOIN(left=semantic_factors, right=light_records, join_type=inner, condition=semantic_factors.incident_id = light_records.incident_id)
ground_events := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id,label])
  -> FILTER(label = 'Conflict Ground Conflict' OR label STARTS_WITH 'Ground Incursion ' OR label STARTS_WITH 'Ground Excursion ')
  -> DEDUP([incident_id])
)
joined := JOIN(left=factors_with_light, right=ground_events, join_type=inner, condition=factors_with_light.incident_id = ground_events.incident_id)
joined
-> GROUP_BY([light_group,visual_factor], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id)})

query: Among Human Factors- or Procedure-primary incidents with flight-crew experience records, how are structured people distributed by crew function and the narrative role of their experience? Normalize crew function to captain, first_officer, single_pilot, instructor, or other_flight_crew, and classify experience as causal, incidental, or not_mentioned. For each represented combination, include the person count and medians of total, aircraft-type, and last-90-days flight hours when recorded.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
experience_rows := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, person_factors.csv, [incident_id,person_ref,factor_type,value])
  -> FILTER(factor_type = 'experience' AND value CONTAINS 'Flight Crew')
  -> PROJECT([incident_id,person_ref,total_hours=PARSE_NUMBER_AFTER(value,'Flight Crew Total'),type_hours=PARSE_NUMBER_AFTER(value,'Flight Crew Type'),last_90_days_hours=PARSE_NUMBER_AFTER(value,'Flight Crew Last 90 Days')])
)
person_rows := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, person_attributes.csv, [incident_id,person_ref,attribute,value])
  -> FILTER(attribute IN ('function','qualification','location_of_person'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id,person_ref], {function_value:MAX_IF(value,attribute='function'),qualification:MAX_IF(value,attribute='qualification'),location_of_person:MAX_IF(value,attribute='location_of_person')})
)
person_experience := JOIN(left=experience_rows, right=person_rows, join_type=inner, condition=experience_rows.incident_id = person_rows.incident_id AND experience_rows.person_ref = person_rows.person_ref)
structured_people := (
  person_experience
  -> PROJECT([incident_id,person_ref,crew_function=CASE WHEN function_value CONTAINS 'Captain' THEN 'captain' WHEN function_value CONTAINS 'First Officer' THEN 'first_officer' WHEN function_value CONTAINS 'Single Pilot' THEN 'single_pilot' WHEN function_value CONTAINS 'Instructor' THEN 'instructor' ELSE 'other_flight_crew' END,total_hours,type_hours,last_90_days_hours,qualification,location_of_person])
)
incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id,primary_problem,text_file])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem IN ('Human Factors','Procedure'))
)
joined := JOIN(left=structured_people, right=incidents, join_type=inner, condition=structured_people.incident_id = incidents.incident_id)
joined
-> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=joined.text_file, [incident_id,text])
-> SEM_GROUP_BY("For each structured person, classify that person's experience as causal when low or recent experience, training, qualification, or unfamiliarity contributed; incidental when mentioned only as context; or not_mentioned when absent. Use function, qualification, and location to resolve the narrative role.", target_labels=[causal,incidental,not_mentioned], input_bindings={incident_id,person_ref,crew_function,qualification,location_of_person,text})
-> GROUP_BY([crew_function,experience_role], {person_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id,person_ref),median_total_hours:MEDIAN(total_hours),median_type_hours:MEDIAN(type_hours),median_last_90_days_hours:MEDIAN(last_90_days_hours)})

query: Among flight-phase and aircraft-operator combinations with at least twenty candidate incidents carrying an ATC assistance or advisory, evasive-action, reorientation, equipment-problem recovery, or go-around result, which five have the highest successful safety-barrier rate? A report is successful only when its narrative clearly describes a hazard being detected, an intervention being made, and a worse consequence being avoided or the situation being stabilized. Rank by higher rate, higher successful-incident count, flight phase alphabetically, and aircraft operator alphabetically; include both counts and the rate.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
candidate_events := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id,event_type,label])
  -> FILTER(event_type = 'result' AND label IN ('Air Traffic Control Provided Assistance','Flight Crew Took Evasive Action','Flight Crew Became Reoriented','Flight Crew Overcame Equipment Problem','Air Traffic Control Issued Advisory / Alert','Flight Crew Executed Go Around / Missed Approach'))
  -> DEDUP([incident_id])
)
incidents := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id,flight_phase,aircraft_operator,text_file])
  -> FILTER(flight_phase IS NOT NULL AND aircraft_operator IS NOT NULL)
)
joined := JOIN(left=candidate_events, right=incidents, join_type=inner, condition=candidate_events.incident_id = incidents.incident_id)
joined
-> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=joined.text_file, [incident_id,text])
-> SEM_GROUP_BY("Classify every candidate as successful_barrier only when the narrative explicitly describes a hazard being detected, an intervention being made, and a worse consequence being avoided or the situation being stabilized; otherwise classify it as not_fully_supported.", target_labels=[successful_barrier,not_fully_supported], input_bindings={incident_id,text})
-> GROUP_BY([flight_phase,aircraft_operator], {candidate_incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id),successful_barrier_count:COUNT_DISTINCT_IF(incident_id,barrier_status='successful_barrier')})
-> FILTER(candidate_incident_count >= 20)
-> PROJECT([flight_phase,aircraft_operator,candidate_incident_count,successful_barrier_count,successful_barrier_rate=successful_barrier_count/candidate_incident_count])
-> ORDER_BY([successful_barrier_rate DESC,successful_barrier_count DESC,flight_phase ASC,aircraft_operator ASC])
-> LIMIT(5)
-> PROJECT([rank=ROW_NUMBER(),flight_phase,aircraft_operator,candidate_incident_count,successful_barrier_count,successful_barrier_rate])

query: Within Part 121 airport-associated reports that contain a recorded automation detector or result, which ten cross-incident pairs describe similar alerts and operational contexts but contrasting first crew responses? A pair qualifies only when one response is follow_advisory and the other is override_advisory or seek_clarification_before_acting. Rank pairs first by the more consequential reported outcome using emergency_or_diversion, go_around_or_evasive_action, then continued_operation, and break ties by the two incident IDs in ascending order. For each pair, identify the shared alert or advisory in at most six words and the two response labels.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
extracted_alerts := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, far_part, locale_reference_type, result_summary])
  -> FILTER(far_part = 'Part 121' AND locale_reference_type = 'Airport')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Emit one row when an automation alert or aircraft advisory and the crew's first response are clear. Extract alert_or_advisory in at most six words, first_crew_action, operational_context in at most eight words, and highest_outcome from {emergency_or_diversion,go_around_or_evasive_action,continued_operation}.", {incident_id:string, alert_or_advisory:string, first_crew_action:string, operational_context:string, highest_outcome:string}, {incident_id,result_summary,text})
)
automation_events := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(event_type IN ('detector','result') AND label CONTAINS 'Automation')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {automation_event_labels:COLLECT(label)})
)
alert_candidates := JOIN(left=extracted_alerts, right=automation_events, join_type=inner, condition=extracted_alerts.incident_id = automation_events.incident_id)
response_records := (
  alert_candidates
  -> SEM_GROUP_BY("Classify the first crew action as follow_advisory, override_advisory, or seek_clarification_before_acting.", target_labels=[follow_advisory,override_advisory,seek_clarification_before_acting], input_bindings={first_crew_action,alert_or_advisory,text})
)
